name: DigitInput
description: Collects a fixed-length verification or personal identification code.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Gets or sets the combined value.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Sets the hidden submitted field name.

events.name: input
events.description: Emitted while the entered code changes.

events.name: change
events.description: Emitted when every field contains a valid character.

events.name: noora-input
events.description: Emitted with the current code after a valid input.

events.name: noora-complete
events.description: Emitted when every field contains a valid character.

events.name: noora-invalid
events.description: Emitted when an entered or pasted value is rejected.

notes: The component emits `noora-complete` when every field contains a character.

examples.title: Input types
examples.description: Choose numeric, alphanumeric, or alphabetic validation.
examples.markup:
<noora-digit-input type="numeric" characters="6" placeholder="•"></noora-digit-input>
<noora-digit-input type="alphanumeric" characters="4" placeholder="•"></noora-digit-input>
<noora-digit-input type="alphabetic" characters="3" placeholder="•"></noora-digit-input>

examples.title: Character counts
examples.description: Collect short, medium, and long codes.
examples.markup:
<noora-digit-input characters="4" placeholder="•"></noora-digit-input>
<noora-digit-input characters="6" placeholder="•"></noora-digit-input>
<noora-digit-input characters="8" placeholder="•"></noora-digit-input>

examples.title: One-time codes
examples.markup:
<noora-digit-input characters="6" one-time-code placeholder="•"></noora-digit-input>
<noora-digit-input characters="4" one-time-code placeholder="0"></noora-digit-input>

examples.title: States
examples.description: Compare default, disabled, and error states.
examples.markup:
<noora-digit-input characters="4" placeholder="•"></noora-digit-input>
<noora-digit-input characters="4" placeholder="•" disabled></noora-digit-input>
<noora-digit-input characters="4" placeholder="•" error></noora-digit-input>

examples.title: Placeholders
examples.description: Use dots, dashes, or empty fields.
